text:
Maya: Quick callout — Starter Hub sample stacks: microcopy and tab focus order feel off on mobile. Screenshot coming but wanted to flag before design sync.

Ian: Yep saw that too in the test build, CTA overlaps card shadow on narrow widths and the text contrast is kinda low. :thinking:

Sasha: Keyboard nav is surprising — tab sequence currently goes header > card image > controls. We want card container -> primary CTA -> secondary action -> overflow. Right now screen readers announce things out of order.

Priya: Agree. Thinking we should move the primary CTA visually to the top-right of the card but keep DOM order in the logical reading order to avoid SR issues. Will try `aria-label` on the CTA and hide decorative elements with `aria-hidden`.

Ian: I'll prototype a DOM-first approach so visual and accessibility orders match. Will push branch `feature/starter-hub-cta` later today.

Sasha: Also add focus-visible outlines and ensure CTA text meets 4.5:1 contrast. Quick snippet we used elsewhere:```html
<button class="primary" aria-label="Create demo project">Create demo project</button>
```
Make sure the button has `:focus-visible` styles and no reliance on color alone.

Maya: Copy suggestion: replace generic "Start" with "Create demo project" (more explicit), and default project name -> "Starter app" instead of "My Project". Shorter, recognizable for newcomers.

devex-bot: Reminder — run axe-ci on the feature branch and tag @eng-qa. We have baseline rules for tab order, ARIA, and color contrast.

Priya: I'll update the microcopy and prepare a 5-user guerrilla usability quick test tomorrow AM. Would like Maya + Ian to join.

Ian: Count me in. I'll also run a local keyboard walkthrough and paste any failing selectors here.

Maya: I'm in. After the tests we can decide whether CTA should be inside card or persistent in the rail. If inside, ensure DOM order equals visual order or add aria-roledescription for clarity.

Sasha: One more nit — make sure sample-stack cards have `role="listitem"` and the container `role="list"` so AT sees the grouping. Also `aria-roledescription="sample stack"` helps.

Priya: Thanks — I'll push copy + a11y checklist to the branch and ping when ready.

Maya: Awesome, thanks team :thumbsup:
